name: fathom
description: Fathom an unfamiliar repository — to fathom is to deeply understand; the root is the nautical depth unit, measured line by line downward, the shape of this plugin's ladder. One skill: repo — climb Repository → Runtime → System → Behavior → Code with one reconstruction-or-prediction gate per level, collapse rules for small repos, level-matched visual forms (terminal diagrams by default), and a persistent study cursor that resumes across sessions. The learner's predictive mental model is the deliverable, not a document. Method evidence lives in the etudes lab; this plugin executes the converged rhythm. Language-agnostic.
